name: mantle
description: Build and embed Mantle applications with version-matched SDK guidance.

interface.longDescription: Use the bundled Mantle skill and version-matched SDK docs to build or extend an app. When requested, deploy it with the bundled Mantle Host skill and Cloud MCP.
defaultPrompt: Create a Mantle app. Use the bundled Mantle skill to help me choose a host and features.
Add Mantle to my existing app. Inspect its stack and follow the version-matched SDK docs.
Deploy my Mantle app to Mantle Cloud with the bundled Mantle Host skill and Cloud MCP.
